svg.title: Chai sleeve dieline — royal
svg.text: Top arc 262 mm · bottom arc 209 mm · band 62.7 mm deep · arc radii 309.0 / 246.3 mm
Fits a 12 oz, 90 mm-rim hot cup. Glue flap 12 mm, left end. Art shown at 1:1 in mm.
Artwork lives outside the cup only; ask for low-migration inks and the converter’s food-contact statement.
